extension.summary: Unofficial Tastemade videos and optional live TV
extension.description:
Browse VOD shows, movies, seasons and episodes with programme artwork, summaries and clear navigation.
Use an eligible Tastemade account to play entitled, provider-declared unencrypted HLS videos. Your profile can reuse its viewing session, verify sign-in and sign out locally.
Optional live TV opens the current channel list directly and uses compatible InputStream Adaptive. Live TV is off by default; installation or enabling is offered only with your consent when you choose Play.
Keeps Kodi's native views and playback controls. Includes original generic icon and background artwork, not official service branding.
extension.disclaimer: Independent, unofficial add-on; not affiliated with or endorsed by Tastemade. Service/content names identify their respective owners. Eligible account permissions are required; no purchase, DRM or region bypass is provided. Password masking does not encrypt saved settings. Media/session URLs may appear in native Kodi or player logs; review logs before sharing and protect reusable credentials. Original artwork is not a legal guarantee of trademark clearance.
extension.news: Prepared the permanent plugin.video.tastemade identity and standalone installation guide. Earlier development builds use a separate settings profile; sign in again after installing this add-on. Includes VOD and season browsing, optional direct InputStream Adaptive live TV and original icon/fanart.

extension.description: Reviewed independent add-ons, selected by Kodi version.

extension.summary: Channels DVR Hub: Dashboard, guide, recordings and passes for Kodi
extension.description: Channels DVR Hub is an ALPHA client for Kodi 21 Omega only, connecting to a user-configured Channels DVR. Connected DVR functionality remains untested for this release. Its Program entry opens a Dashboard with Guide, Recordings, Scheduled, Pass list, Search and Connection navigation. Explicit Play hands completed DVR recordings and advertised live channels to Kodi's native player; OK keeps opening details. Live tuning requires confirmation because shared tuner availability is unknown. Schedule future recordings and manage programme-only and Series passes with separate confirmations and verified local consent. Series management supports Name, pause/resume and removal, including explicit adoption of existing supported passes. Advanced rule editing, DVR resume/watched synchronization and native PVR replacement are not provided. Historical native results from Hub 0.1.0 and the old EPG identity do not establish acceptance of this 0.1.2 candidate.
extension.disclaimer: Unofficial ALPHA add-on for Kodi 21 Omega only. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Channels or Fancy Bits, LLC. Project support: https://github.com/kcook98765/script.channelsdvr.hub/issues . Playback, scheduling, pass management and connected DVR behavior have not been natively accepted for this release. Use only your own authorized DVR and content with the required subscription and server build. Channels DVR may use another available source. Preview matches do not guarantee future coverage. Saved rules stay on the DVR after you exit Kodi. Private operation history is retained; no automatic changes or retries.
extension.news: 0.1.2 ALPHA: adds the project support route, reproducible original artwork and explicit Omega-only alpha limitations. No new functional acceptance is claimed. 0.1.1 pre-release: Settings and Connection accept the same numeric DVR IP address forms and use HTTP port 8089 when omitted. Address requirements and automatic connection behavior are explained in settings. 0.1.0: local Channels DVR Hub identity alignment with a separate Kodi add-on/profile identity. Dashboard, guide, recording management, explicit native Play and programme-only/Series pass management retained. 0.1.2 native acceptance pending; Hub 0.1.0 and old EPG results remain historical.
